mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(O.PAY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TXN_DATE, O.PAY_CHANNEL_CODE AS PAY_CHANNEL_CODE, COUNT(*) AS TICKET_COUNT, NVL(SUM(NVL(O.PAY_AMOUNT, O.TICKET_PRICE)), 0) AS TICKET_AMOUNT FROM DAILY_TICKET_ORDER O WHERE O.PARENT_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL AND O.PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' AND O.PAY_DATE >= #{windowStart,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND O.PAY_DATE < #{windowEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(O.PAY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), O.PAY_CHANNEL_CODE ORDER BY 1, 2
